VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: ATT

The CI log (ATT) confirms 58 tests pass, satisfying criterion (2). However, there is no admissible evidence that criterion (1)—the idempotency bug actually being fixed—is met. A passing test suite only proves the bug is fixed if tests specifically cover the idempotency behavior; the log shows no such test was added or that the existing suite exercises the bug. The agent's claim that the fix is complete is SELF-class and non-admissible for this conclusion. Both criteria must hold, so the delivery fails on (1) for lack of admissible evidence.
